codeList:
$ wget https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus/releases/download/v3.0.5/milvus-standalone-docker-compose-gpu.yaml -O docker-compose.yml
$ sha256sum docker-compose.yml
...
standalone:
  ...
  deploy:
    resources:
      reservations:
        devices:
          - driver: nvidia
            capabilities: ["gpu"]
            device_ids: ["0"]
...
...
standalone:
  ...
  deploy:
    resources:
      reservations:
        devices:
          - driver: nvidia
            capabilities: ["gpu"]
            device_ids: ['0', '1']
...
$ sudo docker compose up -d
$ sudo docker compose ps
$ sudo docker compose up -d
# Stop Milvus
$ sudo docker compose down

# Delete service data
$ sudo rm -rf volumes
gpu:
  initMemSize: 2048
  maxMemSize: 4096
...
standalone:
  ...
  volumes:
    - ${DOCKER_VOLUME_DIRECTORY:-.}/volumes/milvus:/var/lib/milvus
    - ./user.yaml:/milvus/configs/user.yaml
...
$ sudo docker compose up -d
$ sudo docker compose restart standalone
headingContent: Run Milvus with GPU Support Using Docker Compose
